tools.name: get_market
tools.description: DexScreener market data for a token address (price, liquidity, FDV, pair age, 24h buys/sells).

tools.name: x_profile
tools.description: X account stats: followers, age, verification, bio.

tools.name: x_search
tools.description: X posts for a query (ticker, address, project name, narrative keyword). Up to 20 posts. type: Latest (default) or Top (most engaged).

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Visible text of a web page. Only URLs that appear in the messages or the dossier are allowed.

tools.name: browse_site
tools.description: Open a website in a real browser (JavaScript rendered) and read it, its buttons, and up to 3 of its own pages about tasks, quests, points, rewards or mint. Use it for points/testnet/quest/mint sites and apps rendered by JS. Only sites from the message or the dossier.

tools.name: trends
tools.description: What is trending now: top trending pools on a chain (GeckoTerminal), boosted tokens (DexScreener) and what SCARF's communities discuss most in 24h. Use it to judge whether a token rides a live narrative or copies one.

tools.name: mentions
tools.description: How many authors and servers mentioned a key recently. Key format: evm:0x.., sol:<mint>, ticker:abc, domain:x.com, x:handle, collection:slug.

tools.name: emit_verdict
tools.description: Final answer. Call exactly once when the analysis is done.

verdict.description: act = take the action now; watch = interesting but not yet; ignore = nothing here; avoid = likely scam/loser

intents.description: Only when verdict=act. Addresses/URLs/functions copied exactly from the Discord messages.

asset.description: perp_trade: market ticker as named in the message (BTC, ETH, SOL…).

leverage.description: perp_trade: leverage from the call if stated (code caps it).

stopPrice.description: perp_trade: stop-loss price (required by risk rules; code sets a default if missing or invalid). prediction_bet: sell if the outcome price falls to this (0..1).

takeProfitPrice.description: perp_trade: take-profit price. prediction_bet: sell before resolution at this price (0..1); omit to hold to resolution.

stopLossPct.description: token_call: your stop-loss, % below entry (code allows only tighter than its default stop, min 5%). Put the level that invalidates your thesis (e.g. FDV falls back below X).

takeProfitX.description: token_call: take-profit as a multiple of entry (e.g. 1.5 = +50%).

takeProfitShare.description: token_call: share to sell at take-profit, 0.25–1 (1 = full exit for a quick flip).

sellByHours.description: token_call: sell no later than N hours after entry whatever the price (quick trades).

marketSlug.description: prediction_bet: market slug exactly as in dossier.predictions[].slug.

collection.description: nft_buy: OpenSea collection slug exactly as in dossier.nft[].slug (buy the cheapest listing).

maxPriceEth.description: nft_buy: the most you would pay for one NFT, ETH; above it — skip.

outcome.description: prediction_bet: outcome name exactly as in the dossier (e.g. "Yes", "No", a candidate name).

limitPrice.description: prediction_bet: the most you would pay per share (0..1); above it the bet is skipped.

sourceIdx.description: Chat batch only: number [n] of the message this action comes from.

exits.description: Held positions to close now (token address exactly as in the portfolio).

sourceIdx.description: Chat batch only: message [n] with the warning.

sizeFactor.description: Optional: shrink the risk-gate size (never grows it).

recheckAfterMinutes.description: For watch: when a re-check makes sense.

recheckAtUtc.description: Exact ISO UTC times to re-check (e.g. 30 min before public mint).

projects.description: One entry per distinct project in the message.

ref.description: Key from the case (collection:slug, domain:site.xyz, evm:0x.., sol:.., ticker:abc) or the exact name.

publicNote.description: For act and watch projects: the X note about THIS project (PUBLIC NOTE rules). Empty for ignore/avoid.

changeReason.description: If your earlier verdict on this project (project history, 24 h) differs: the new fact that changed it.

nftPlan.description: For NFT mints: flip = list at floor right after mint; hold = wait for targetMultiple of cost or sellByUtc.

thesisStrength.description: How concrete and verifiable the reasons for upside are (0 = vibes, 10 = clear catalyst + data).

expectedHoldHours.description: Expected hours until the main take-profit.

publicNote.description: For act and watch: posted on X as-is under SCARF's name (see PUBLIC NOTE rules). English, first person, 1-2 sentences, max 230 characters (190 for a token: the post adds its CA). For ignore/avoid: empty string.

changeReason.description: Only when the project history shows your earlier verdict on this project (last 24 h) and this one is different: the NEW fact that changed it (new contract, new market data, a condition met, a new credible source). Empty otherwise. Code keeps the earlier verdict if you raise it without a reason.
